pricing.details: Official prices in euro. 300 trial credits once, no card — a one-time trial, not a lasting free plan. Personal 20 €, 100 € or 200 € per month including VAT, or ×10 per year (200 €, 1,000 € or 2,000 € per year). Team 25 €, 125 € or 250 € per person per month excluding VAT. No official yearly Team total is published on the pricing page. Credit top-up: 400 credits for 10 €.
